digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API / external integration tests
propositions: Public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in pre-1.0 breaking pass but two external test modules still call it, causing 4 CI lanes to fail with AttributeError.
External test modules are excluded from the Verified gate and were not exercised by the removal epic's retargeting pass, making the regression invisible until live workflow_dispatch.
Retargeting is not a mechanical rename: review_plan returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (no top-level findings), while the tests expect REVIEW_RESULT contract with runner/model/findings.
Both test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py were successfully retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code (the surviving op with matching result contract) and validated live.
